parts.name: NavigationMenuRoot
parts.description: The `<nav>` that holds which item is open and shares it with the parts inside.

props.name: value
props.description: The open item's value, or `null` for none. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the menu.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The item open at first, when the menu isn't controlled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called once per change with the open item's value, or `null` when it closed, including when the browser closed it (Escape, a press outside). It is called in a change of its own, after the menu's: a request it starts, or a handler that is itself an action, doesn't hold the menu.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Whether the list runs `horizontal`ly or `vertical`ly: which arrow keys move along it and which one opens an item.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long the pointer rests on a trigger before its content opens, in milliseconds. While another item is open, the switch is immediate.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: How long after the pointer leaves the trigger and its content before the content closes, in milliseconds.

parts.name: NavigationMenuList
parts.description: The `<ul>` of items. It is one Tab stop: the arrow keys along the orientation, Home and End move between its triggers and links, without wrapping.

parts.name: NavigationMenuItem
parts.description: An `<li>` in the list: a link, or a trigger with its content.

props.name: value
props.description: Identifies the item; the root's `value` names the open one. Without it the item gets a generated id.

parts.name: NavigationMenuTrigger
parts.description: The button that opens its item's content: on hover after the root's delay, on a press, and with ArrowDown (ArrowRight in a vertical menu), which also moves focus into it. Its `popovertarget` keeps a press on it from counting as a press outside the content.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A disabled trigger doesn't open its content on hover, press or keys.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the trigger is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focusable
dataAttributes.description: Always present: tells the list's arrow keys to stop on the trigger even while it is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while its content is open.

parts.name: NavigationMenuIcon
parts.description: A `<span>` inside the trigger for a chevron or similar, hidden from assistive technology. It shows whether its item is open with `data-popup-open`.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while its item's content is open.

parts.name: NavigationMenuContent
parts.description: The item's panel: an element with `popover="auto"`, declared after the item's trigger and placed against it with CSS anchor positioning. Focus leaving it, other than to its trigger, closes it. Style it with `:popover-open` and `@starting-style`.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the trigger the content sits on. The browser flips it when it doesn't fit.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the trigger the content lines up with, along the side.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: The gap between the trigger and the content, in pixels.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: How far the content is moved along the trigger's edge from its `align` position, in pixels.

dataAttributes.name: data-activation-direction
dataAttributes.description: While the content is open after another item's was: where that item was, `left` or `right` (`up` or `down` in a vertical menu).

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of the trigger the content is on: the `side` asked for, then the side the browser placed it on once open.

parts.name: NavigationMenuLink
parts.description: A link, in the list or in some content. In the list it is one of the arrow-key stops; in content it is an ordinary link.

props.name: active
props.description: Whether the link is the current page: it gets `aria-current="page"` and `data-active`.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Whether following the link closes the open content.

dataAttributes.name: data-active
dataAttributes.description: Present when the link is the current page.

parts.name: NavigationMenuArrow
parts.description: An element placed on the content's edge that faces the trigger, centred on the trigger. It follows the content when the browser flips it. Give it a shape in CSS and turn it per `data-side`.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of the trigger the content is on. Absent until the content first opens; a close keeps the last side.
